resultsSummary: Num 16:46: MT imperative (HC/Vpv2ms); LXX ἐξιλάσεται in B vs ἐξίλασαι in A and F (Swete 1887 apparatus, OCR) — LOCATOR_HOLD on the reading
Lev 17:11: Swete 1909 digital transcription (Sollupulo) has transcription errors (ψυχὴ, ἐχιλάσεται); other mirrors agree on ἀντὶ τῆς ψυχῆς ἐξιλάσεται; Swete 1887 apparatus records only F omitting τῆς
Exod 25:17 (MT) = LXX 25:16 in Swete 1909 and eliranwong; LSJ cites 'LXX Ex.25.16(17)'
Exod 30:12: article variant (Swete: Κυρίῳ; Studylight: τῷ κυρίῳ) — LOCATOR_HOLD
Lev 17:11 'ἐξειλάσεται B*' from wave 1 NOT supported by Swete 1887 apparatus at 17:11; the B* spelling variant is recorded at Num 16:46 instead
NT: ἐξιλάσκομαι absent from NT (lemma search, SBLGNT via MorphGNT); ἱλάσκομαι Lk 18:13, Heb 2:17; ἱλασμός 1 Jn 2:2, 4:10; ἱλαστήριον Rom 3:25, Heb 9:5; λύτρον Mt 20:28, Mk 10:45; ἀντίλυτρον 1 Tim 2:6
BDB: כפר has several entries under Strong 3722 (kipper; denominative 'pitch' Gen 6:14); כֹּפֶר homonyms (ransom; pitch; henna); כַּפֹּרֶת: 'lid' rejected by BDB 1906
